message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine appropriate charge(s) for the case.

Facts: A police auxiliary (协警) named 虞1某, a state organ worker, during a vehicle check, seized drugs from a drug dealer Liu. He then, at request of Liu, hides two bags of methamphetamine (甲基苯丙胺) in his uniform pocket, later hides one bag in wall corner, later flushes one bag down toilet, and turns himself in, surrendering the other bag (25.26g). He helped conceal and destroy evidence, aiding a drug dealer to evade prosecution. The indictment says his behavior as a state organ worker, knowingly helping a drug dealer hide drugs and destroy evidence, violates criminal law, second paragraph (likely article 380? Actually article 380 is "窝藏、包庇罪" - harboring, sheltering). The list includes "窝藏、包庇". Also there is "非法持有毒品" but he is a state worker, but he didn't possess for personal use; he concealed and destroyed evidence. The appropriate charge is "窝藏、包庇". Also maybe "非法持有毒品" but the list includes "非法持有毒品". However the description: He concealed drugs, which is a form of "窝藏、包庇" (harboring). The list includes "窝藏、包庇". So answer: [罪名]窝藏、包庇<eoa>.

Check if any other charges: He also destroyed evidence (冲走, flush). Could be "妨害作证"? No. "妨害作证" is interfering with testimony. Not relevant. "玩忽职守"? He neglected duty, but the main is "窝藏、包庇". The list includes "徇私舞弊不移交刑事案件" but that's about not handing over criminal case. Not exactly. So final answer: "窝藏、包庇".
